entities.summary: First Lieutenant Adolf Opálka was a Czech army officer. He was a member of the Czech sabotage group Out Distance and a participant in Operation Anthropoid, the successful mission to kill Reinhard Heydrich.

entities.summary: First Lieutenant Adolf Opálka was a Czech army officer. He was a member of the Czech sabotage group Out Distance and a participant in Operation Anthropoid, the successful mission to kill Reinhard Heydrich.
